independent_internal_checks: Both sequential triangular transformations have explicit inverses, preserve diagonalizable weights, and retain every formal branch coefficient; distinct N=2 directions give the second chart even in characteristic two.

Full rank-one A-chain modules trivialize on the two-axis complement. Full line multidegrees and proper strict-local base change kill the n-torsion Brauer group on the resolution. Purity and secondary residues propagate a single parameter, realized by the actual (u,w) symbol.
The descent nerve uses finite disjoint Artinian thickenings and prime-to-p nilpotent invariance, retaining the nonreduced diagonalizable group when p divides N.
The actual finite central extension has commutator radical of order N(L/h)^2. The residual commutative extension is a Kummer character line, not an assumed split scalar inertia.
The central radical has exactly N(L/h)^2 characters of scalar weight one. Each nondegenerate quotient block has dimension h, independently of the scalar coefficient order n.
Neutralization is only over the preimage of mu_N. Its character is not assumed to extend to all H. Chosen deck lifts, their actual central multiplication defects, and their nth powers are retained.
Full-Hom extension applies to maps defined on the whole contracted puncture. It extends the line and object transports and identities to one chosen full coefficient-gerbe extension.
The scalar phase formula retains the fixed nth-power isomorphism, has corrections in [0,p-1], closes for n=p^f-1>1, and explicitly separates n=1.
The effective product-ideal discrepancy has endpoints zero and slopes bounded by p+k; charging it to inherited C still requires the actual prior Jacobian hypothesis.
